reviews.text: Emily and her entire staff are some of the most knowledgable, dependable and dog-loving people I've ever met! I was on the hunt for a smaller boarding/daycare environment for my nervous pup because he doesn't thrive in bigger facilities with tons of dogs. My first phone call with Emily was great - I could tell right away she had the expertise and genuine care for all dogs that I was looking for. I'm so happy I found Down to Earth Dogs and so is my pup!! We get pictures and texts during all of his stays and he always comes home exhausted, happy and ready for his next playdate with all his friends.

It is very difficult for me to leave our dog when we travel. I have found no better place to trust with the care of our Caliesi than Down to Earth Dogs.

Emily Keaney provides a beautiful yard where our dog gets to romp with a small group of dogs. Caliesi is always excited to be there and comes home tail wagging.

All dogs are screened for vaccinations and for appropriate social behavior.

I strongly suggest you check out Down to Earth Dogs.  I am so happy I did and can travel knowing our dog is getting the best of care!

Our dog was a little shy and was literally welcomed by the other dogs to come and be part of their group. We’ve taken Cali to Down to Earth dogs for day camp and she comes home happy and tired. We love the photos they send us during the day of what Cali is doing.  She’s also gone for a week stay and frankly, Cali disappointed to see us return.  Emily and her staff know so much about dogs that we feel very comfortable leaving Cali in her care.

Emily and Bella are amazing!! I have been taking my dog Harley for a few months now and I'm so impressed. Emily and Bella are super kind, patient, and knowledgeable about dogs and their personalities. My dog started off super shy and needed some additional socialization and he loves getting dropped off to play and I've seen a huge improvement with him.  They send me pic updates throughout the day and I'm very comfortable leaving him with them knowing he will be taken care of. The facility is clean and safe, and Harley always comes home so tired which is great. Highly recommend them!!

Emily and her team are the best! They have different play and rest areas for the dogs, send great pictures, are communicative and flexible, and offer feedback and tips on your pup’s behavior. Fiona loves Down to Earth and I’m so happy to bring her there!

Emily, Bella, and company are fantastic caretakers of our 4 legged family members. Bindi always enjoys her time there and they're always quick to get back to any questions or concerns you have as owner throughout the day. They're good at identifying who is shy & chill and who is energetic, anxious, etc. They also give feedback about your pup and of course, daily pics of them having fun in the sun or keeping cool in the shade. Easy recommendation.

I had such a wonderful experience with Cookie's stay at Down to Earth Dogs.  She was so comfortable and happy there. You can tell that Emily and Bella genuinely love what they do. They really took the time to get to know Cookie's personality and needs, giving her the individual attention that made all the difference.
What I loved most was how they treated Cookie like she was their own dog. They sent me updates and photos that showed her having a great time, and when I picked her up, she was clearly relaxed and well-cared for. You can see right away that they're true animal lovers who really care about every dog in their care. I would recommend them to anyone looking for compassionate pet care where their dog will be treated with genuine love and attention.

My dog Chip loves Down to earth dogs. He comes home happy, tired and well socialized. The staff is friendly and caring. It’s great to know  my dog is not only being watched but genuinely cared for and loved. I highly recommend to any dog parent.

Emily, Bella and Drew are the most amazing caregivers! I started bringing Makana to them when she was just 15 weeks old. Emily was gracious enough to take on a puppy while I was on a 16 day trip. I received pictures and videos each day and felt completely comfortable that my baby girl was in capable hands.
I truly appreciate that the team at Down to Earth Dogs treats our babies as their own. I can't say enough positive things about these ladies. They are top notch and I highly recommend them!

I am so glad I found Down to Earth dogs! Emily, the owner, is so helpful and supportive of me and my dog. She went above and beyond to make sure the environment would fit for my dog. We did a few trials and she was really intentional about the whole process. She’s also very intuitive with my pup and knew her cues almost immediately. And I know everyone that works there (Bella, Drew & Alison) love her. She goes to daycare weekly and has also boarded there overnight a few times. My pup is always so happy to go and I love getting pictures that show how happy she is. This is the perfect environment for my pup and I’m so grateful for it. Thanks Emily, Bella, Drew & Alison. Dolly loves you!

My dogs love coming here. We started with doggy daycare a few years ago when they were puppies and they have spent a lot of time staying here for vacations. Emily, family, and staff are amazing!! They even threw a birthday party for Pepper when we booked a trip over her doggy birthday. Money well spent knowing our dogs are not only safe but loving their time here. Highly recommended. Worth every penny!
